description: Today's value of one PackIndex code — commodity inputs (L0: oil, gas, power, metals, recovered fibre), raw materials (L1: PP, HDPE, pulp…), semi-finished (L2: kraftliner, films…) or finished packs (L3) — in USD (and your currency), with 1-week / 1-month / 3-month / 1-year change (each period only where that much history exists) and carbon data where scored. Free callers get a 12-week delayed reference value (plus a daily live rotation); live values need the Essential plan.

code.description: PackIndex code, e.g. PP, KRLNR, OCC, GAS_TTF, CORR. Use search_indices if unsure.

currency.description: Also show the value in this currency (ISO code, e.g. EUR, CAD). Defaults to the signed-in user's own currency; converted at live FX.

name: get_live_index
title: Get one index value
